**Title:** Secure Assessment Student Assigned Exam Discovery Browser UI Integration Bootstrap

## 1. Description
This Build Unit introduces the frontend product capability for "Full browser-facing assigned-exam discovery" identified as a remaining Milestone 1 gap. It allows a student to view and discover their assigned exams, bridging the gap to the BU-084 Attempt Launch UI. 

## 2. Requirements & Scope
- **IN SCOPE:** 
  - Define and implement a browser UI component for listing assigned exam schedules.
  - Integration with the authoritative `frontend/web/src` workspace.
  - Strict adherence to the `frontend-design` v1.1.0 and Visual Foundation v1.0.0.
  - Verification with frontend typecheck, automated test pass, and mobile-first responsive rendered verification.
- **OUT OF SCOPE:** 
  - Real Authentication (PB04 remains OPEN, carried forward).
  - Proctor / Teacher operational views (deferred to successor).
  - No new database schema mutations.
